Agent Team Builder for OpenClaw: First Release

- Guides users step-by-step through creating a custom multi-agent team on OpenClaw, from team design to architecture, agent setup, routing, and collaboration rules.
- Explains key OpenClaw conventions and architecture, including workspace isolation, agent identities, and recommended channel strategies.
- Provides interactive questions, validated choices, and ready-to-use configuration/workspace file templates.
- Ensures all instructions and file structures reflect verified OpenClaw documentation as of early 2026.
- Designed to trigger for any user requests involving multi-agent setups, agent collaboration, or team configuration.
